newsitem.title: USA: Conrail merger filing now targeted for next week.
newsitem.headline: Conrail merger filing now targeted for next week.

text.p: CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp are expected to submit plans for their proposed purchase of Conrail Inc to federal regulators early next week, according to sources familiar with the process.
The two railroads, which want to buy the East Coast freight carrier for $10.3 billion in cash, originally had hoped to file the plan with the federal Surface Transportation Board on June 16.
However, the prospective buyers said earlier this week that the filing had been delayed due to the complexity of the document, which contains more than 15,000 pages.
CSX and Norfolk Southern would not comment on a specific date for the filing.
The sources stressed that the delay is due to logistical difficulties and the proposed deal is not in jeopardy.

The two railraods have proposed buying Conrail in a joint transaction and then dividing the assets. The plan to be submitted to the federal agency is expected to contain details about capital expenditures, cost savings and other information.
